def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    orders = db["orders"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    entities = list(entity_ids)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entities, name="product_id"))

    # Только продажи, произошедшие ДО seed_time
    items_past = order_items[
        (order_items["product_id"].isin(entities)) &
        (order_items["ts"] <= seed_time)
    ]

    # 1. Агрегаты за всю предшествующую историю
    if not items_past.empty:
        agg_all = items_past.groupby("product_id").agg(
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            n_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
            total_price=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            mean_price=("price", "mean"),
            mean_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            std_price=("price", "std"),
            std_freight=("freight_value", "std"),
            n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            min_ts=("ts", "min"),
            max_ts=("ts", "max")
        )
        features = features.join(agg_all)

    # 2. Временные признаки
    if "max_ts" in features.columns:
        features["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - features["max_ts"]).dt.days
        features["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features["active_days"] = (features["max_ts"] - features["min_ts"]).dt.days
        features = features.drop(columns=["min_ts", "max_ts"])

    # 3. Окна 30/60/90/180 дней
    for win in [30, 60, 90, 180]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=win)
        items_win = items_past[items_past["ts"] > cutoff]
        if items_win.empty:
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_orders"] = 0
            features[f"win{win}_cnt_items"] = 0
            features[f"win{win}_sum_price"] = 0.0
            features[f"win{win}_mean_price"] = 0.0
        else:
            agg_win = items_win.groupby("product_id").agg(
                cnt_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
                cnt_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
                sum_price=("price", "sum"),
                mean_price=("price", "mean")
            ).add_prefix(f"win{win}_")
            features = features.join(agg_win)

    # 4. Признаки на основе отзывов — только отзывы, УЖЕ созданные к seed_time
    if not items_past.empty and not reviews.empty:
        rev_past = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
        if not rev_past.empty:
            order_rating = rev_past.groupby("order_id")["review_score"].mean().rename("avg_review").reset_index()
            prod_orders = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
            prod_orders = prod_orders.merge(order_rating, on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not prod_orders.empty:
                rating_agg = prod_orders.groupby("product_id")["avg_review"].agg(
                    avg_review_score="mean",
                    n_reviews="count",
                    pct_positive_reviews=lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() * 100
                )
                features = features.join(rating_agg)

    # 5. Платежи (только по заказам, произошедшим до seed_time)
    if not items_past.empty and not payments.empty:
        pay_past = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
        if not pay_past.empty:
            prod_orders = items_past[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates()
            po = prod_orders.merge(
                pay_past.groupby("order_id").agg(
                    pay_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
                    pay_installments=("payment_installments", "mean")
                ), on="order_id", how="inner")
            if not po.empty:
                pay_agg = po.groupby("product_id").agg(
                    pay_value_mean=("pay_value", "mean"),
                    pay_installments_mean=("pay_installments", "mean"))
                features = features.join(pay_agg)

    # 6. Глобальные календарные признаки
    features["month"] = seed_time.month
    features["quarter"] = seed_time.quarter
    features["day_of_week"] = seed_time.dayofweek
    features["year"] = seed_time.year

    # 7. Флаг наличия продаж
    features["has_sales"] = (features["n_orders"].fillna(0) > 0).astype(int)

    features = features.fillna(0.0)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0.0)
    features = features.astype(float)
    features.index.name = "product_id"

    return features
